# BinVM
A lightweight, experimental virtual machine designed for high-performance bytecode execution.

## About
BinVM is a minimal, custom bytecode interpreter built for low-resource environments and experimentation.

## Features
- Lightweight and fast
- Minimal memory footprint
- Custom bytecode format
- For educational and experimental use

## Build
```bash
gcc binvm.c -o $PREFIX/bin/binvm
```
## Run
```bash
binvm
```
